1	-- Row-Level Security (RLS) for multi-tenant isolation
2	-- Ensures each flight school can only access its own data at the database level.
3	-- Application must call: SELECT set_config('app.flight_school_id', '<uuid>', true)
4	-- before any tenant-scoped query.
5	
6	-- Helper: get the current tenant ID from session variable
7	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_current_flight_school_id() RETURNS uuid AS $$
8	  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.flight_school_id', true), '')::uuid;
9	$$ LANGUAGE sql STABLE;
10	
11	-- Helper: check if current session is superadmin (bypasses RLS)
12	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_superadmin() RETURNS boolean AS $$
13	  SELECT COALESCE(current_setting('app.is_superadmin', true), 'false')::boolean;
14	$$ LANGUAGE sql STABLE;
15	
16	-- Enable RLS and create policies for all tenant-scoped tables.
17	-- Pattern: SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE restricted to matching flight_school_id or superadmin.
18	-- INSERT requires flight_school_id to match context or superadmin.
19	
20	-- Note: Auth tables (user, session, account, verification) are platform-wide
21	-- and intentionally excluded from RLS.
22	
23	DO $$
24	DECLARE
25	  tbl TEXT;
26	BEGIN
27	  FOR tbl IN
28	    SELECT unnest(ARRAY[
29	      'locations', 'users', 'equipment', 'equipment_maintenance',
30	      'schedule_events', 'schedule_standby', 'schedule_standby_entries',
31	      'classes', 'class_enrollments', 'invoices', 'fuel_invoices',
32	      'logbook_entries', 'student_notes', 'student_flags', 'student_holds',
33	      'student_tags', 'student_certificates', 'student_endorsements',
34	      'student_course_balances', 'curricula', 'curriculum_versions',
35	      'curriculum_stages', 'curriculum_modules', 'curriculum_placements',
36	      'module_tasks', 'module_topics', 'module_resources', 'module_regulations',
37	      'module_endorsements', 'module_assignments',
38	      'plans_of_action', 'stage_check_results', 'stage_check_schedules',
39	      'checkride_packets', 'checkride_slots', 'checkride_history',
40	      'checkride_task_templates', 'packet_templates',
41	      'announcements', 'direct_messages', 'conversations', 'chat_sessions',
42	      'email_templates', 'sms_consent', 'sms_logs',
43	      'branding_configs', 'billing_config', 'grading_settings',
44	      'signup_flow_config', 'tc_versions', 'tc_agreements',
45	      'onboarding_documents', 'onboarding_status',
46	      'location_permissions', 'location_notifications',
47	      'location_document_popup_config', 'location_endorsement_templates',
48	      'location_role_required_documents',
49	      'team_members', 'team_member_locations',
50	      'instructor_aircraft_checkouts', 'instructor_feedback',
51	      'school_billing_rate_history', 'school_payment_methods',
52	      'flow_overrides', 'integration_usage',
53	      'workflows', 'support_tickets', 'help_articles', 'help_categories',
54	      'lms_courses', 'lms_units', 'lms_lessons', 'lms_enrollments',
55	      'lms_progress', 'lms_guide_assignments',
56	      'course_standalone_students', 'course_standalone_instructors', 'course_waitlist',
57	      'assignment_completions', 'chat_feedback',
58	      'ai_schedule_history', 'flight_dispatches',
59	      'acknowledgment_rules', 'acknowledgment_records',
60	      'aircraft_make_models', 'widget_template_installs',
61	      'audit_log', 'audit_logs'
62	    ])
63	  LOOP
64	    -- Skip if table doesn't exist (some may not be created yet)
65	    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = tbl AND table_schema = 'public') THEN
66	      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', tbl);
67	
68	      -- Drop existing policies if any (idempotent)
69	      EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON %I', tbl);
70	      EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_insert ON %I', tbl);
71	
72	      -- Read/Update/Delete policy
73	      EXECUTE format(
74	        'CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON %I USING (flight_school_id = get_current_flight_school_id() OR is_superadmin())',
75	        tbl
76	      );
77	
78	      -- Insert policy
79	      EXECUTE format(
80	        'CREATE POLICY tenant_insert ON %I FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (flight_school_id = get_current_flight_school_id() OR is_superadmin())',
81	        tbl
82	      );
83	
84	      RAISE NOTICE 'RLS enabled on %', tbl;
85	    ELSE
86	      RAISE NOTICE 'Skipping % (table not found)', tbl;
87	    END IF;
88	  END LOOP;
89	END $$;
90

Confirmed. `setTenantContext`/`clearTenantContext` are defined only in `db-tenant-context.ts` with zero call sites anywhere else in `src/`, and `app.flight_school_id` never appears elsewhere either — no middleware, no route file sets it. Migration 0144 does enable RLS with `tenant_isolation`/`tenant_insert` policies (verified: ~80-table loop, `USING (flight_school_id = get_current_flight_school_id() OR is_superadmin())`) gated on `current_setting('app.flight_school_id')`. Since nothing ever calls `set_config`, every query runs with that GUC unset → `get_current_flight_school_id()` returns NULL → the policy's `flight_school_id = NULL` is never true, and `is_superadmin()` defaults to `false` when unset — so the RLS policy filters out ALL rows for ALL tenants rather than acting as silent no-op passthrough. That's actually a slightly different (arguably worse for availability, though not a leak) mechanism than the finding's "safety net is a no-op" framing — but the core claim (RLS deployed, never activated, `setTenantContext` never called) is fully verified as fact.

Severity: CRITICAL is justified — ADR-002 (multi-tenant isolation) is a protected decision (PDD-002 area doesn't cover this exactly, but ADR-002 is cited as the architecture doc), and this is a compliance/security-relevant gap on aviation training data across ~80 tables. Confidence: high, matches finder's own confidence tag.
